title: Merrit the Little Ferry and the Sleepy Lake Crossing
description: A little ferry carries three sleepy friends across Silvermist Lake on a slow evening crossing, then rests beneath the silver moon.

Merrit.role: Main character; a little toy-like passenger ferry
Merrit.color: Muted seafoam-teal hull, warm cream cabin, dusty coral roof, and a small honey-yellow chimney
Merrit.bodyShape: Short rounded compact ferry hull with cream-framed twin front windows, wooden passenger bench, short cream railings, and a hinged boarding ramp at the bow; no wheels, sails, arms, or legs
Merrit.face: Friendly eyes only in the two front cabin windows, one eye per window, with a small curved smile on the cream panel beneath
Merrit.accessories: None; no lettering, logos, numbers, or anchor decorations

Rabbit.color: Oatmeal-cream fur with blush-pink inner ears and a powder-blue scarf
Rabbit.bodyShape: Tiny plush-clay rabbit with long softly rounded ears; tallest of the three passengers
Rabbit.face: Dark bead eyes, small pink nose, and a gentle sleepy expression

Hedgehog.color: Cocoa-brown body with caramel quills, peach-beige face, and a moss-green scarf
Hedgehog.bodyShape: Tiny plush-clay hedgehog; smallest of the three passengers
Hedgehog.face: Dark bead eyes and a gentle sleepy expression

Duckling.color: Butter-yellow feathers with a peach-orange rounded beak
Duckling.bodyShape: Tiny plush-clay duckling with short rounded wings; mid-sized among the three passengers
Duckling.face: Dark bead eyes and a gentle sleepy expression

settingBible.Silvermist Lake: A small peaceful freshwater lake with rounded pine-covered hills, a western departure dock, and an eastern destination dock with soft amber lamps
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded ferry and animal friends, lavender evening fading to midnight indigo, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Merrit keeps seafoam-teal hull, cream cabin, dusty coral roof, honey-yellow chimney, and eyes only in the two front windows.
Passengers are exactly the rabbit, hedgehog, and duckling on pages 2–14 only; page 1 and page 15 show Merrit alone.
Narration never states exact dock lamp counts; use soft wording such as little lights.
Ferry travels west to east without reversing; both docks stay simple weathered wood.
No rescue, danger, rough waves, lettering, logos, or numerals in artwork.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: At the edge of Silvermist Lake lived Merrit, a little ferry who loved carrying friends home before bedtime.
pages.illustrationScene: Wide elevated view of seafoam-teal ferry Merrit waiting beside a wooden dock on still lavender Silvermist Lake.
pages.continuityNotes: Merrit alone; passengers absent. Soft lamp wording only later; no exact lamp counts.

pages.text: One evening, three sleepy friends arrived for Merrit's very last crossing.
pages.illustrationScene: Rabbit, hedgehog, and duckling approach Merrit's open boarding ramp at the departure dock.
pages.continuityNotes: Passengers board from page 2; present through page 14. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: All aboard, whispered Merrit. Tonight, we'll take the slow and gentle way.
pages.illustrationScene: Low three-quarter view as the rabbit steps onto Merrit's boarding ramp with hedgehog and duckling following.
pages.continuityNotes: Boarding at departure dock. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: The rabbit chose a cozy seat, the hedgehog curled beside her, and the duckling tucked in close.
pages.illustrationScene: Medium deck shot of rabbit, hedgehog, and duckling sitting together on Merrit's wooden bench.
pages.continuityNotes: Passengers seated on Merrit's bench. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: Merrit gave a tiny happy hum, and the lake answered with a soft, sleepy ripple.
pages.illustrationScene: Close low waterline view of Merrit's smiling bow leaving the dock with soft rounded ripples.
pages.continuityNotes: Leaving western dock toward eastern shore. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: Across the lake, the evening mist floated like little blankets over the water.
pages.illustrationScene: High bird's-eye view of Merrit crossing open lake through thin mist ribbons toward distant pines.
pages.continuityNotes: West-to-east crossing; mist over water. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: Look, whispered the duckling. The clouds are getting ready for bed together.
pages.illustrationScene: Over-the-shoulder from the duckling looking past Merrit's railing at long pink-violet clouds.
pages.continuityNotes: Cloud watching from deck. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: The rabbit yawned a great big yawn, and soon the hedgehog yawned one too.
pages.illustrationScene: Side-profile deck shot of rabbit and hedgehog yawning while the duckling watches sleepily.
pages.continuityNotes: Passengers growing sleepy. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: Merrit slowed his little engine, but it kept a quiet, steady purr.
pages.illustrationScene: Close three-quarter side view of Merrit's rounded face and cabin with gentle hull reflections.
pages.continuityNotes: Engine slows; no splashing. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: Above the sleepy lake, the first stars appeared, one by one.
pages.illustrationScene: Extreme wide low shoreline view of small Merrit under darkening indigo sky with emerging stars.
pages.continuityNotes: First stars; crescent moon may appear later. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: Almost home, murmured Merrit, as the little lights of the far dock came into view.
pages.illustrationScene: Over-the-shoulder toward the destination dock with soft amber lamps glowing through mist under a crescent moon.
pages.continuityNotes: Destination dock lamps visible; narrate soft lights only, never exact lamp counts.

pages.text: The duckling leaned against the rabbit, and the hedgehog made one last tiny yawn.
pages.illustrationScene: Intimate close-up of sleepy passengers on Merrit's bench with warm cabin light and cool night lake beyond.
pages.continuityNotes: Passengers nearly asleep. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: With the gentlest little bump, Merrit settled safely beside the quiet homeward dock.
pages.illustrationScene: High three-quarter view of Merrit arriving motionless at the eastern wooden dock in moonlit mist.
pages.timeOfDay: dark midnight arrival at homeward dock
pages.continuityNotes: Arrival at eastern dock; soft dock lamps in art only, no exact lamp counts in narration.

pages.text: Goodnight, Merrit, whispered the friends. Thank you for our lovely, sleepy ride.
pages.illustrationScene: Dockside view of rabbit, hedgehog, and duckling waving to smiling Merrit from the homeward dock.
pages.continuityNotes: Passengers on dock waving goodbye. Final passenger page. No exact lamp counts.

pages.text: Merrit closed his sleepy eyes beneath the silver moon, and Silvermist Lake whispered goodnight to the little ferry.
pages.illustrationScene: Wide view of Merrit resting alone beside the empty dock with closed eyes under crescent moon and stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Passengers gone; Merrit alone and asleep. Soft dock lamps only; no exact lamp counts.
